about: Label audit of the generated scripts by a different model family (Claude, the agent that wrote the scenarios), done by reading every transcript BEFORE any check result was seen (2026-10-10 ~03:30). invalid = the generated text contradicts the scenario label (generator resolved the open fact or left alarm content in a harmless twin); doubtful = label defensible but weak/mixed signals. Metrics are reported on all 74 and on the 65 'clean' scripts (neither invalid nor doubtful).
